title: GNN4PPM: Multi-Target Predictive Process Monitoring with Relational Graph Convolutional Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.14534v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) aims at predicting at runtime and as early as possible the future states of a process execution. Common tasks include predicting the next event, the time to completion of a trace, and outcomes. Existing approaches typically consider an event from the perspective of the executed activities along with their timestamps and case identifiers. This leads to the disadvantage that in real-life settings, there is much more information recorded in the event log that is not captured or completely ignored when performing prediction tasks. We introduce GNN4PPM, an approach that predicts all next events along with their complete data payload at once. We represent event information in a heterogeneous knowledge graph that captures the event log as an RDF semantics, and train the embeddings with a Relational Graph Convolutional Network (R-GCN). translated_title: GNN4PPM：基于关系图卷积网络的多目标预测性流程监控
translated_abstract: 预测性流程监控（PPM）旨在在运行时尽早预测流程执行的未来状态。常见任务包括预测下一个事件、轨迹的完成时间以及结果。现有方法通常从已执行活动及其时间戳和案例标识符的角度来考虑事件。这导致了一个缺点：在现实环境中，事件日志中记录的许多信息在执行预测任务时未被捕获或被完全忽略。我们提出了GNN4PPM，这是一种能够一次性预测所有下一个事件及其完整数据载荷的方法。我们将事件信息表示在异构知识图谱中，该图谱以RDF语义捕获事件日志，并使用关系图卷积网络（R-GCN）训练嵌入。与现有解决方案相比，我们的方法具有广阔前景，实验结果…
tldr: 本文提出GNN4PPM方法，将事件日志表示为RDF语义的异构知识图谱，并利用关系图卷积网络（R-GCN）训练嵌入，实现了对流程中所有下一事件及其完整数据载荷的一次性多目标预测，克服了传统方法忽略事件日志中丰富信息的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GNN4PPM, which represents event logs as heterogeneous knowledge graphs with RDF semantics and trains embeddings using a Relational Graph Convolutional Network (R-GCN), enabling one-shot multi-target prediction of all next events together with their complete data payload while capturing rich information ignored by existing approaches.
